caption: The drawing contains a detailed depiction of a wooden side or console table, shown in a three-dimensional colored rendering at the top and two black-and-white technical elevation views with measurements at the bottom. The rendered table is brown with a light-colored, possibly marble, rectangular tabletop featuring a slightly curved front. The apron below the tabletop has a central ornate carving. The table's base consists of two large, scroll-shaped legs joined at the bottom and top, forming an openwork lyre-like design with a turned decorative finial at the center. The legs are mounted on a substantial, shaped rectangular plinth with additional carved details and four feet. The technical elevation views provide front and side measurements, with dimensions labeled in inches, and reproduce the top, pedestal, and base shapes in outline. The name "Wellington Blewett" appears at the bottom right corner of the page. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Table
